scripts.dev: cd shared && tsc && cd ../bot && nest start --watch --preserveWatchOutput
scripts.dev:all: cd shared && tsc && cd .. && concurrently -n shared,bot,web -c gray,blue,green "cd shared && tsc --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "cd bot && nest start --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "cd webapp && vite"
scripts.build: cd shared && tsc && cd ../bot && nest build && cd ../webapp && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: cd shared && tsc && cd ../bot && vitest run && cd ../webapp && vitest run
